opex.note: Money set aside for customer loans that may not be repaid.

follow100Note: Trading supplied $47.95 of every $100 of revenue — options alone were $26.69 of it ($182M of $682M).
footerNote: Robinhood does not report a separate cost of revenue; 'Brokerage and transaction' — the direct cost of executing customers' trades — is shown as the direct cost here. Expense lines are as re-presented in Robinhood's Q2 2025 Form 10-Q, which splits the provision for credit losses out of operations.

kpis.label: Net deposits
kpis.note: 41% annualized growth vs assets under custody

oneTimers: Reported revenue is after $13M of matches paid to customers on transfers and deposits — an incentive Robinhood nets against revenue (options revenue alone was reduced by $8M in the quarter), so the trading growth underneath was slightly stronger than the headline.

The $3M tax provision is unusually small: Robinhood carried a full valuation allowance against its U.S. federal and state deferred tax assets in Q2 2024. It released that allowance later in 2024, booking a one-time $369M tax benefit in Q4 2024.
otherDetail: Other income, net was $2M — small next to the main business. Income tax was just $3M (a 1.8% effective rate), because Robinhood carried a full valuation allowance against its U.S. federal and state deferred tax assets, partly offset by current taxes payable.

segments.name: Transaction-based revenues
segments.note: Fees from customers' trades — options $182M, crypto $81M, equities $40M and $24M of other trading fees.

segments.name: Net interest revenues
segments.note: Interest on customers' cash and margin loans, plus securities lending — up on growth in interest-earning assets, increased securities lending and higher short-term interest rates.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Mostly Robinhood Gold subscriptions — 2.0M subscribers, up 61%.

sources.label: Form 10-Q, quarter ended June 30, 2025 — re-presented 2024 comparatives (SEC EDGAR)

takeaways.text: Transaction-based revenue rose 69% to $327M — options revenue grew 43% to $182M, crypto jumped 161% to $81M and equities rose 60% to $40M, as customers traded actively across asset classes.
takeaways.title: Trading revenue surged

takeaways.text: Net income was $188M versus $25M a year ago: revenue rose 40% while total operating expenses rose just 6% to $493M. The tax bill was just $3M — Robinhood still carried a full valuation allowance against its U.S. deferred tax assets.
takeaways.title: Profit jumped more than sevenfold

takeaways.text: Net deposits hit a record $13.2B in the quarter — a 41% annualized growth rate against assets under custody, which rose 57% to $139.7B. Gold subscribers rose 61% to a record 2.0M and funded customers reached 24.2M.
takeaways.title: Record net deposits

verdict: Robinhood's revenue rose 40% to a record $682M as options and crypto trading surged — and it turned that growth into $188M of profit, up from $25M a year ago.
